card.name: Mid-sentence words in old formal prose
card.fires_on: Small grammar words (would, could, to, he, be, commas) in the middle of long sentences, mostly in old-fashioned historical, religious or scientific prose. It sits just before the verb or clause that finishes the thought.

modes.label: Modal verbs before a main verb
modes.description: Words like would, could or should that lead into the verb of a long formal sentence.

modes.label: Linking words and commas
modes.description: Commas, dashes, 'to' or 'thereby' that join a clause to the next part of a long sentence.
